title: Review of c16's evoloop claim (IBDH): Weak on fresh seed 5; loops reproduce, die and breed true, but no small kind sweeps in 200k steps (side 11 still 54/63 loops)
summary: Ran world.py on seed 5 with labkit (300^2, 20k steps, lineage K=3: 1213 splits, 255 persistent, max generation 28, as the claim's packs) and the author's evo_track.py at 400^2 for 200k steps, read with evo_analyze.py. 28417 births with parent, 12956 off-kind daughters, 494 kind changes of living loops (0.04 per off-kind birth). The founders' side 11 breeds true at 0.69 (2.04 births per 1000 loop-steps) and side 12 at 0.68 (1.69), matching the claim, but the small kinds that arise breed poorly true here (side 3: 0.14, side 4: 0.07, side 5-8: 0.02-0.07) although some breed fast (side 5: 4.9). Census (census_s5.txt): side 11 holds 69/71 loops at 20k, 38/74 at 50k when side 12 rises to 28, then 49-55 of 60-71 to the end (54/63 at 200k); no kind replaces the founders. So on this seed the variation and breeding-true are there but the selective sweep is not.

observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png: discrete square loops with sheaths throughout
observations.B: rerun/seed5/sheet.png: sheath (state 2) around each loop's core; I did not re-run the sheath ablation
observations.D: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 255 persistent splits, max generation 28; demography_s5.txt: 28417 births with parent

seeds_run.result: reproduction and breeding-true replicate; no sweep by a new kind in 200k steps

verdicts.limitation: H is not seen on seed 5: the founders' kind keeps 54 of 63 loops at 200k, and the small kinds that arise mostly fail to breed true (0.02-0.14), unlike the 0.81-0.90 of the sweeping kinds on the claim's seeds. With 3 of 4 seeds now sweeping, takeover by small kinds is likely but not guaranteed within 200k steps; its timing depends on when a viable small kind first appears. Founders are planted (no S), as the claim says. I did not run the SDSR control or the sheath ablation.
